resources.string: Remove only this downloaded file from the app cache? The message stays in the chat. To open it again, download it again. Sent originals and files in use are not removed.
Downloaded copy removed. The message is unchanged.
Cannot remove this file: it may be in use, outside the app cache, or an original. Stop playback and try again.

Copy this photo to the system clipboard? The app you paste into can read it. The temporary copy is cleaned after an hour while Lunagram runs, or on a later copy. Up to 20 MiB; protected and disappearing media are excluded.
Photo copied to the system clipboard
No saved timestamps for this media. Start this voice message, music track or round video, then choose Save current timestamp. Nothing starts automatically.
Cannot save or read timestamps. The account may have changed, encrypted storage may be unavailable, or the 64-timestamp limit was reached.
Moves the current player to this timestamp without starting playback. Saved timestamps remain available after Ultra expires.
First open this voice message, music track or round video in the player. No playback is started for you.
Repeat a section of the current voice message, music track or round video. Enter mm:ss or h:mm:ss. Stops when media or account changes.
Use valid timestamps within the media, at least one second apart.
A–B repeat enabled for this media
At the end of this media
Timer set for this media. Switching media or account cancels it.
Calculate a fingerprint of the downloaded file locally. Up to 128 MiB. You can cancel; no file contents are uploaded.
Media tools are unavailable. Check the active account and Ultra status, or wait for the current operation to finish.
Cannot read this downloaded copy. Download it first, stop any file transfer, and check the size limit. Originals and protected media are excluded.
